question: If cot A + cos A = p and cot A - cos A = q, then which of the following relation is correct?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put A = 30°, then cot 30° = √3 and cos 30° = √3/2.

⇒ p = √3 + √3/2 = 3√3/2 and q = √3 − √3/2 = √3/2

⇒ p² − q² = (27/4) − (3/4) = 24/4 = 6

⇒ 16pq = 16 × (3√3/2) × (√3/2) = 16 × 9/4 = 36

⇒ √16pq = √36 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is √16pq = p² − q².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
